description: List everywhere a Monitor's Cycles can run from. Each entry's id is what a Monitor's engineIds names — never invent one. Type CLOUD is one of Loadster's shared monitoring locations, and PRIVATE is one of the customer's own Loadster Engines, the only kind that can reach a host on their network. Monitoring locations are their own set, not the load test regions list_engines offers. Read this before create_monitor or update_monitor.
name: list_monitoring_locations
title: List Monitoring Locations
